name: qfd_link_adp512
structural_change: el1013-qwen-romio 10-13: the adapter is no longer routed as the die master (8 loop rows on qfd_io_serdes: 600.048^2 M8-era tile, PHY-sized frame never bound). New: ONE M5 leaf child qfd_link_adp512 shared by qfd_io_serdes (3) and qfd_io_ucie (1), a 237.6 x 583.2 strip (0.139 mm2, was 0.360) with the 8 SRAMs in one column, die-bus pins S (toward the slot's c / r pins) and FDI pins N (toward the PHY relays), recipe 2; the masters become clusters (child + FDI relay stations + PHY macro). UCIe moves from the RXD=32 flop buffer (32 k flops on one root) to this SRAM view.
slot_change_request: el1013-qwen-romio 10-13, for the die lead (masters qfd_io_serdes / qfd_io_ucie, this child sits inside them): (a) bundles c[1023:0] / r[1023:0] are built as c_v + c_d[1023:0] in + c_cr out, r_v + r_d[1023:0] out + r_cr in on the bundle's face (credit against the flow); rst_n and fault are owed in the slot pin list. (b) the 8 x 174.096-wide SRAM column needs a 237.6 um adapter strip (macro >= 20 um from both core edges); the io_serdes frame leaves 157.656 um beside the 2,400.192 x 1,512 PHY abstract: re-shape the ASSUMED PHY abstract to <= 2,320.2 wide (same 3.629 mm2 at 1,564 tall) or widen the slot by 80.0 um. (c) PHY abstracts' FDI flit is 1,041 b (RXD 128) / 1,039 b (UCIe RXD 32): regenerate both with RXD = 512 (1,043 b) in tools/qwen_missing/link_phy_gen.py.

job.purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 link adapter as the M5 leaf child of cluster masters qfd_io_serdes (3) and qfd_io_ucie (1): wiring-only cell qfd_link_adp512 around ot_qfd_link_adapter W=1024 RXD=512 SRAM=1 PINREG=1 (body closed TT +6.61 / FF +16.92 at 600.048^2, M8 era). 237.6 x 583.2, cap M5, pins M4/M5, recipe 2, every port a flop at its pin. Cut: the S->N crossing over an SRAM row is c->tx 1,043 + rx->SRAM/skid ~1,024 = 2.07 k bits vs 4.95 k M5 tracks over the 237.6 um width (M1-M4 blocked over the 174 um macro; the two 31 um side channels add M2-M4) = 0.42 <= 0.60; pin faces 2,052 (S) / 2,089 (N) pins on 4.95 k M5 tracks = 0.42. Clock: ~15.4 k sinks estimated on one root (ci 1,025, IBUF 4,096, tx 1,044, rq 1,044, rb_cap 1,024, skid 4,096, rr + pin 2,050, control): the --cts gate measures it.
